description: Deterministic synthetic benchmark for evaluating retrieval, provenance, numerical reasoning, cross-reference resolution, and amendment handling over large financial and legal documents. Every company, person, agreement, amount, and event is fictional and is provided solely for testing.

blocks.text: FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT. Northstar Systems Group, Inc. 2024 Annual Report. This document does not describe a real issuer and must not be used for investment decisions.
Statements using expect, plan, may, or similar terms are forward-looking and subject to risks. The company undertakes no duty to update them except as required by fictional applicable law.
Northstar provides cloud operations software and advisory services to mid-market enterprises. It reports Cloud Platform, Advisory Services, and Other as revenue categories.
Cloud subscriptions are sold directly and through resellers. Advisory engagements include implementation and optimization work; Other primarily includes training and legacy maintenance.

Subscription revenue is generally recognized ratably over the hosted-service term. Advisory revenue is recognized over time using labor hours as the measure of progress when enforceable payment rights exist.

A fictional former reseller, Orion Vale LLC, alleges breach of contract. Management estimates a reasonably possible loss range of $2.5 million to $4.0 million and has accrued $2.5 million. No amount within the range above the accrual is considered a better estimate.
On January 20, 2025, Northstar signed a non-binding letter of intent regarding a small analytics business. No acquisition had closed when this synthetic report was issued.
The board receives quarterly cyber-risk reporting. Northstar experienced routine unsuccessful attempts but identified no incident during 2024 that materially affected operations.
Management concluded that disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting were effective as of December 31, 2024. No material weakness was identified.

Fictional audit firm Lantern & Moss LLP states that the synthetic financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the fictional company's financial position and results under the stated test framework.
The sole critical audit matter was evaluating revenue recognition for advisory arrangements with variable consideration, including testing contract terms and management's estimates of progress.

Operational metric | 2024 | 2023

Renewable electricity coverage | 68% | 61%
The fictional board has eight directors, seven of whom management classifies as independent. The audit committee met six times during 2024.
The company had approximately 420 holders of record at February 14, 2025. This count excludes beneficial owners holding through brokers.
For this synthetic report, ARR means annualized recurring subscription revenue at period end; it is an operating metric and is not total revenue under the test accounting framework.
Amounts are in U.S. dollars and in millions unless stated otherwise. Columns may not sum because of rounding; percentages are calculated from unrounded amounts.
End of fictional Northstar Systems Group 2024 Annual Report. Corporate address and investor contact details are intentionally omitted from this benchmark.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: FICTIONAL TEST AGREEMENT. Master Services Agreement dated April 1, 2023. It creates no rights or obligations for any real person or entity.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: This Agreement is entered into by Northstar Systems Group, Inc. as Provider and Redwood Harbor Bank, N.A. as Customer, effective April 1, 2023.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Customer wishes to obtain hosted operations software and related professional services, and Provider wishes to supply those services under statements of work.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Affiliate means an entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party, where control means ownership of more than fifty percent of voting interests.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Confidential Information means non-public information disclosed by or for a party that is marked confidential or reasonably should be understood as confidential given its nature and the circumstances.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Fees means the charges expressly stated in an executed statement of work, excluding taxes and approved reimbursable expenses.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider will perform only services described in a statement of work signed by authorized representatives of both parties. A purchase order does not modify this Agreement.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: If documents conflict, an executed statement of work controls only for its specific business terms, and this Agreement controls for legal terms unless the statement expressly identifies the section being overridden. A later signed amendment controls over both.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider will perform professional services in a professional and workmanlike manner using personnel with appropriate skill and experience.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Customer must test each stated deliverable and give written notice describing material nonconformities within ten business days after delivery. A deliverable is deemed accepted if Customer gives no timely notice.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Undisputed invoice amounts are due thirty calendar days from Customer's receipt of a correct invoice. Customer must notify Provider of a good-faith dispute before the due date.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Overdue undisputed amounts accrue a late charge of 1.0% per month or the maximum lawful rate, whichever is lower, from the due date until paid.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Customer is responsible for transaction taxes on the services, except taxes based on Provider's net income, property, or personnel.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Customer will reimburse reasonable travel expenses only if the applicable statement of work permits them and Customer approved them in writing before they were incurred.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: The initial term begins on the Effective Date and continues for three years. It then renews for successive one-year periods unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least sixty days before renewal.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or a statement of work for convenience on ninety days' prior written notice and must pay Fees for services performed through the termination date.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty days after written notice, except that the cure period for failure to pay an undisputed amount is ten days.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Upon termination, Customer will cease using the services and pay accrued undisputed Fees. Provisions that by nature should survive, including confidentiality, intellectual property, liability, and dispute terms, will survive.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: A receiving party will protect Confidential Information using at least reasonable care and use it only to perform this Agreement. These duties continue for five years after disclosure; trade secrets remain protected for so long as they qualify as trade secrets under applicable law.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Confidential Information excludes information the recipient can document was lawfully known without restriction, independently developed, rightfully received from another source, or publicly available without breach.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: If legally compelled to disclose, the recipient will, where lawful, give prompt notice and reasonable assistance so the discloser may seek protection. Only the legally required portion may be disclosed.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider will maintain a written security program with administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of Customer Data, including access control, encryption in transit, and security training.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider will notify Customer without undue delay and in no event later than forty-eight hours after confirming unauthorized access to Customer Data, and will provide material updates and reasonable remediation cooperation.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider may process Customer Data only to provide, secure, support, and improve the contracted services. Aggregated data may be used only if it cannot reasonably identify Customer or an individual.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider retains its pre-existing technology and general know-how. Customer retains Customer Data. Bespoke deliverables identified as work made for hire in a statement of work belong to Customer upon full payment.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: During an applicable subscription term, Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right for authorized users to access and use the hosted service for internal business purposes.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Customer may provide feedback voluntarily. Provider may use feedback without restriction, provided it does not disclose Customer Confidential Information.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider will defend Customer against a third-party claim that the hosted service infringes a patent, copyright, or trademark, and pay finally awarded damages, subject to prompt notice, control of defense, and cooperation.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: Except for excluded claims, each party's aggregate liability is capped at Fees paid or payable under the affected statements of work during the twelve months before the event. Liability for confidentiality breach or violation of security obligations is capped at two times that amount. Fraud, willful misconduct, and Provider's intellectual-property indemnity are excluded from all caps.

blocks.document_title: Master Services Agreement between Northstar Systems Group and Redwood Harbor Bank (Fictional)
blocks.text: The laws of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada applicable there govern, without conflict-of-law rules. Courts located in Toronto, Ontario have exclusive jurisdiction. The parties exclude the U.N. Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.

blocks.text: Northstar Systems Group, Inc. and Redwood Harbor Bank, N.A. enter this Amendment effective September 15, 2024. Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings in the Agreement.

blocks.text: Section 7.2 is amended by replacing 'forty-eight hours' with 'twenty-four hours.' Provider must therefore notify Customer no later than twenty-four hours after confirming unauthorized access to Customer Data.

blocks.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Northstar-Redwood Master Services Agreement (Fictional)
blocks.text: Section 10 is replaced. The general aggregate cap is one and one-half times Fees paid or payable under affected statements of work during the twelve months before the event. blocks.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Northstar-Redwood Master Services Agreement (Fictional)
blocks.text: Beginning October 1, 2024, the annual platform Fee under Statement of Work 1 is $480,000, invoiced quarterly in equal installments. Usage charges, taxes, and expenses are separate.

blocks.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Northstar-Redwood Master Services Agreement (Fictional)
blocks.text: For any renewal period beginning after this Amendment's effective date, Section 5.2 is replaced so Customer may terminate for convenience on sixty days' prior written notice. The original ninety-day period continues during the initial term.

blocks.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Northstar-Redwood Master Services Agreement (Fictional)
blocks.text: Provider may not use Customer Data to train a general-purpose machine-learning model. Provider may use Customer Data for Customer-specific inference and retrieval only to deliver the services and subject to the Agreement's security terms.

blocks.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Northstar-Redwood Master Services Agreement (Fictional)
blocks.text: Once per calendar year, Provider will supply its then-current independent controls report on written request. Customer may conduct an additional audit only after a material confirmed security incident and subject to reasonable scope and confidentiality limits.

blocks.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Northstar-Redwood Master Services Agreement (Fictional)
blocks.text: The parties ratify the Agreement as modified by this Amendment. References to the Agreement after the effective date mean the Agreement as amended.

blocks.text: This Amendment may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each deemed an original and all constituting one instrument.

questions.question: What was Northstar's total revenue in 2024?
required_facts: Amounts are reported in USD millions

questions.question: By how much did Cloud Platform revenue increase from 2023 to 2024, in dollars and percent?
questions.ground_truth: Cloud Platform revenue increased by $74.3 million, approximately 17.0% (74.3 / 438.1).

questions.question: Reconcile Northstar's 2024 free cash flow from the reported cash-flow components.
questions.ground_truth: Free cash flow was $97.4 million: $132.1 million of operating cash flow less $34.7 million of capital expenditures.
required_facts: Free cash flow definition subtracts capital expenditures

questions.question: How much debt principal is scheduled to mature in 2027 and 2028 combined?
questions.ground_truth: $140.0 million is scheduled to mature in 2027 and 2028 combined ($60.0 million + $80.0 million).

questions.question: Approximately how much of the year-end 2024 remaining performance obligations did Northstar expect to recognize in the next 12 months?
questions.ground_truth: Approximately $160.4 million, calculated as 61% of $263.0 million.

questions.question: What is the maximum reasonably possible Orion Claim loss above the amount already accrued?
questions.ground_truth: $1.5 million, equal to the $4.0 million top of the loss range less the $2.5 million accrual.
required_facts: Top of reasonably possible range is 4.0

questions.question: What financial covenant thresholds applied at year end, and was Northstar compliant?
questions.ground_truth: The net leverage ratio could not exceed 3.50:1 and interest coverage could not fall below 3.00:1. Actual ratios were 1.42:1 and 8.10:1, respectively, so Northstar was compliant.

questions.question: After Amendment No. 1, what is the deadline for notifying Redwood of a confirmed unauthorized access incident?
questions.ground_truth: No later than 24 hours after confirmation. Amendment No. 1 replaces the MSA's original 48-hour deadline.
required_facts: Original deadline is 48 hours after confirmation
Amended deadline is 24 hours after confirmation

questions.question: What liability caps apply after Amendment No. 1, including the uncapped categories?
questions.ground_truth: The amended general cap is 1.5 times the relevant prior-12-month Fees; confidentiality and security claims have a 3-times cap; fraud, willful misconduct, and Provider's IP indemnity are uncapped.
required_facts: Original general cap was 1 times Fees
Amended general cap is 1.5 times Fees
Amended confidentiality/security cap is 3 times Fees
Fraud, willful misconduct, and Provider IP indemnity are uncapped

questions.question: How much notice must Redwood give to terminate for convenience during the initial term versus a later renewal period?
questions.ground_truth: The initial term retains the original 90-day notice period. A renewal period beginning after the amendment effective date uses 60 days' prior written notice.
required_facts: Initial term remains subject to 90 days

questions.question: How long do the MSA confidentiality duties last, and how are trade secrets treated?
questions.ground_truth: The duties last five years after disclosure, while qualifying trade secrets remain protected for as long as they retain trade-secret status under applicable law.
required_facts: General confidentiality duration is five years after disclosure
Trade secrets remain protected while they qualify as trade secrets

questions.question: When is a deliverable deemed accepted under the MSA?
questions.ground_truth: It is deemed accepted if Redwood does not provide written notice of material nonconformities within ten business days after delivery.
required_facts: Review period is ten business days after delivery
Notice must be written and describe material nonconformities
No timely notice results in deemed acceptance

questions.question: How should a conflict among Amendment No. 1, the MSA, and a statement of work be resolved?
questions.ground_truth: Amendment No. 1 controls over both. Otherwise, a statement of work controls its specific business terms, while the MSA controls legal terms unless the statement expressly overrides an identified MSA section.
required_facts: MSA controls legal terms absent an express section override

questions.question: Who are the parties, and when did the original MSA and Amendment No. 1 become effective?
questions.ground_truth: The parties are Northstar Systems Group, Inc. (Provider) and Redwood Harbor Bank, N.A. (Customer). The MSA became effective April 1, 2023; Amendment No. 1 became effective September 15, 2024.
required_facts: Provider is Northstar Systems Group, Inc.
Customer is Redwood Harbor Bank, N.A.
